title: Layer-3 narrative (đánh giá toàn diện) for one chart style — data/live/narrative/<style>.json
description: Wyckoff phase grammar is enforced by scripts/check-narrative.py: phases contiguous from A (A, A-B, A-B-C, …) in chronological order; event labels start with a Wyckoff event name (PS/SC/AR/ST/UA/Spring/Shakeout/Test/LPS/SOS/BU · PSY/BC/UT/UTAD/SOW/LPSY) and sit in their own phase; Phase A needs SC/BC, Phase C needs a test event (Spring/Shakeout/Test/LPS[C]/UTAD), Phase D needs SOS/LPS/BU (SOW/LPSY); SOS/SOW on volume < 1.0× is refused (WA p83–84 — that is UA/UT). Written ONLY by the daily full analysis (Sonnet). Rendered by scripts/build-artifact.py; validated by scripts/check-narrative.py (numbers from facts/candles, method purity via scripts/method_purity.py, consistency with data/live/anchors.<style>.json). Every per-method text uses only that method's vocabulary; Wyckoff-vs-ICT de-duplication (knowledge/integrated/method.md §4.3) is stated ONLY in synthesis_html. Events and phases are addressed by candle time, never by index. Write atomically (temp file + rename).

style.description: The nine derived style names: three horizons (scripts/automation.py HORIZON_TF -- scalping 15m, day 1h, swing 4h) x three markets -- crypto bare, cfd- and fx- prefixed. Never authored here; this enum mirrors automation.STYLE.values().

source.description: one line: which snapshot/brief this analysis was made from

mode.description: The confluence mode this read was produced under (docs/architecture/methods.json -> modes). SOLO was missing here until 2026-09-17, which made the `wyckoff` and `ict` presets unrecordable: both declare mode SOLO (methods.json presets), so a genuine single-method run had to either lie NORMAL or fail validation. build-artifact.py does not derive page text from this field -- the lede and glossary read the engaged lanes -- but check-narrative.py validates it, so the enum had to admit the value the registry can produce.

lookback_html.description: 'Nhìn lại' — what resolved since the previous analysis; cross-method allowed (synthesis vocabulary)

synthesis_html.description: 'Hiện tại' — the combined read, verdict reasoning, de-duplication statement, invalidation owner. Any vocabulary.

structure.description: tích lũy | phân phối | tái tích lũy | tái phân phối | chưa xác lập

phase.description: A–E, or null when the CHoCH gate is not evidenced

status.description: P6.2 (docs/audits/2026-09-24-wyckoff-label-review.md): 'tested' requires the phase's own confirming event (Spring/Shakeout/Test/LPS[C]/UTAD for C; SOS/SOW/LPS/LPSY/BU for D) to exist and be CONFIRMED (no trailing '?'); anything else is 'hypothesis' (method.md A4). Enforced by scripts/check-narrative.py; drawn dashed with a '?' suffix by scripts/chart.js when missing or 'hypothesis'.

label.description: Wyckoff vocabulary only, ≤ 28 chars, e.g. 'SC 76,676 · KL 7.88×'. A LPS/BU/LPSY/Test/SOS/SOW event not yet confirmed by its own deterministic test (P2.1/P3.1) must end in '?' (WA p93/p161's own candidate notation) — a '?' event cannot open a later phase.

up.description: true = flag above the candle high, false = below the low

event_class.description: P1.1: the WA event name being typed (Spring/Shakeout/UA/UT/UTAD/…), recorded separately from the WMT volume type so the two vocabularies are never collapsed (method.md A6).

volume_type.description: P1.1 (WMT Bảng 2.1/2.2, p049/p064): REQUIRED on every Spring/Shakeout event. Checked by scripts/check-narrative.py against the ratio computed from candles — not trusted from the model.

volume_kind.description: P5.1: which volume this ratio is (scripts/instruments.py is_tick_volume); a tick-fed symbol may not use volume as the sole validator of the event (WMT p131-133).

doi_nhan.description: P1.1 (WA p150-159, đối nhãn/mislabelling tests; scripts/wyckoff_rules.py R3/R3b): required whenever phases or events are present.

st_sign.description: WA p150 Dấu hiệu 1: where ST[A] sits in the TR's thirds. 'contradicts' blocks the phase from advancing past C unless `alternative` AND the synthesis both name the contradiction.

phase_b_sign.description: WA p154-159 Dấu hiệu 2: where the Phase-B tests sit.

alternative.description: P6.1 (WA2-27): REQUIRED whenever phases or events are present — a short cited paragraph naming the competing reading and what would decide between them.

nesting.description: P4.2: where the working-timeframe range sits inside the higher-timeframe one (price position plus the HTF event it coincides with, if any; WA2-19/20). Required whenever a context read exists.

text_html.description:
Wyckoff read in Wyckoff vocabulary only (price + volume);

paragraphs each ending in …
ICT read in ICT vocabulary only — no Wyckoff event names, no volume (knowledge/integrated/method.md §4.1)
Wyckoff vocabulary allowed as foundation; no ICT vocabulary

event.description: neutral description of what price did

context.description: The higher-timeframe overview chart (e.g. 4H×180 for scalping, whose bias rung is 4h). Numbers must come from that style's own facts (scripts/local-eval-brief.py swing) or its candles.
